body:
video:https://streamable.com/0xhihy   🌱 Automatic Bamboo Planter

Automatic Bamboo Planter is a lightweight Minecraft mod that automatically replants bamboo after it is harvested.

This makes bamboo farms fully renewable and reduces the need for manual replanting.

Features

Automatically replants harvested bamboo

Works in both Singleplayer and Multiplayer

Lightweight and performance friendly

Designed for survival gameplay

Compatibility

Supports: (1.21.1)

Loader: (Fabric)
